Matthew chapter 10 verses 32 and 33, whoever acknowledges me before men, I will also

name Christian, not because you took it upon yourself. No, there's great security

Lord, we pray that you would send your spirit and that you would create true

Lord, we ask that you would give us that the great desire
not to trust in our reputation, our history,
our past in any way,
but that our trust would be holy in you,
that our dependence would be holy in you,
and that your present life
